app_copy.title: Money held safely
app_copy.caption: The buyer pays into escrow, not into your inbox.

job: Make 'held' physical. The money is somewhere neither party can reach, and the seller is untroubled by that.

style.reference: Retro Halftone Editorial Line Illustration v1.0
style.medium: vector illustration emulating screen-print / risograph, flat paper grain, no gradients
style.line_work: heavy hand-inked black outlines 6-10px at 2048px canvas, moderate weight variation (thicker at joints and contact points), confident single-stroke, gently wobbly organic corners, rounded terminals, contours occasionally left open at intersections, minimal interior detail — 1 to 3 crease lines per shape
style.shading: coarse visible round halftone dots, ~45 LPI equivalent, 45 degree angle, ONE flat density per shape, never a gradient ramp
style.values: exactly three readable values — ground, halftone grey, solid black. Midtones are ALWAYS dithered dots, never flat grey.
style.figures: high abstraction, geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, mitten-simple fingers, small head relative to body, profile or three-quarter face with ONE curved-line eye, single bold nose and lip contour, no pupils, no nostrils, no ear detail, hair as a solid black graphic mass with a hard silhouette
style.value_separation: every figure reads as a solid-black garment against a halftone garment — two halftone masses must never touch without a black shape between them
style.accent_marks: small abstract ink marks — asterisk/spark, single arcing swoosh, 2-3 short motion dashes. Maximum 2 marks per image.
style.ground_line: one long horizontal ink line anchoring the scene, no drawn floor and no furniture legs
style.composition: flat, no perspective, no horizon, no background scenery, at least 35% empty ground, asymmetric with the weight low
style.text_policy: NO text, letters, numbers or symbols rendered inside the image — the app renders all copy in Plus Jakarta Sans

casting.context: Ghanaian social commerce — sellers trading through WhatsApp and Instagram DMs, mobile money, hand-wrapped parcels
casting.represent: Ghanaian adults, 20s to 40s, everyday sellers and buyers running a business
casting.avoid: tribal-print decoration, huts, drums, wildlife, poverty signifiers, aid imagery, generic 'African' motifs
casting.tone_rule: Calm is the product. No panic, no celebration, no shouting poses. Bodies are relaxed and confident.

scene.subject: a large rounded-rectangle strongbox centre stage, plus a Ghanaian man with a low fade
scene.pose: the man leans his back and one shoulder against the box, arms folded, one ankle crossed over the other, completely at ease
scene.props: strongbox with a halftone dot body and a heavy solid black lid with a single wide slot across the top. One long elongated arm enters from the left frame edge dropping a simple rectangular banknote toward the slot.
scene.accent_marks: two short motion dashes trailing the falling note
scene.placement: box centred slightly left, man on the right, empty ground above

prompt: Retro mid-century editorial illustration on a flat #F1F1EF ground. A large rounded-rectangle strongbox stands centered on the ground, its body filled with coarse halftone dots and its heavy lid a solid black slab, with a single wide slot across the top. From the left, one long elongated arm reaches in and drops a simple rectangular banknote toward the slot. On the right, a Ghanaian man with a low fade leans his back and one shoulder against the box, arms folded, one ankle crossed over the other, completely at ease — his shirt solid black, his trousers halftone. Two short motion dashes trail the falling note. Bold uneven hand-inked black outlines, flat solid black fills, coarse visible halftone dot shading, strictly three values, no color, no gradients, no soft shadows. Simplified geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, profile face with one curved-line eye and a bold minimal nose, solid black graphic hair. Single horizontal ground line. Square 1:1, generous negative space, screen-print risograph texture. No text anywhere in the image.
negative_prompt: flat grey fills instead of halftone dots

caption_variant.when: social posts, App Store screenshots, landing page — NOT in-app
caption_variant.caption: not in your inbox.
caption_variant.add_to_prompt: Large lowercase bold Helvetica Neue caption 'not in your inbox.' set flush-left in the upper-left with very tight leading, generous margin from the edge, never overlapping the figure.

qa_checklist: Exactly three values present — no fourth grey
Every midtone is visibly dotted at 100% zoom, dots individually countable
Box body halftone reads clearly against the solid black lid
Banknote is a plain rectangle with no denomination or currency mark
The leaning man is relaxed, not guarding the box
